changelog.note: Initial capture as user 1 on Asta with full access: a QA-AUTO task was created disabled, opened, switched on and off for a few seconds and deleted through the UI. Run now and the Try saying suggestions are never used because they send to Telegram or the assistant and spend its budget. Tasks made by tests are QA-AUTO tasks, always saved with Enabled off, and are deleted through the UI.
